leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a recursive Angular component that renders nested tree data
Initialize and bind component state to represent hierarchical tree nodes
Implement click handlers to control the expansion and collapse of tree branches
Configure component inputs to accept dynamic tree data structures
Apply conditional rendering to display nested child nodes recursively
Manipulate component state to track which tree nodes are currently expanded
Integrate the recursive TreeView component into a parent application view
